text:
morgan: Quick heads-up — I'm drafting the release note for the staging cutover tonight 23:00 UTC. Pin candidate is v2.3.1 (model-router + runtime tweaks). Can ops + docs review?
lee: Ack. I'll run the smoke canary at 22:30 UTC and report. Any specific failure thresholds?
anita: Proposed rollback: immediate rollback if 5xx error rate > 1% over 5m OR median latency > 800ms for 2 consecutive 5m windows. Sounds ok?
morgan: Yes. Also noting a config change: dispatcher concurrency default bumped from 8->12 for this release. Watch cache hit ratio.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window: staging @ 2025-11-03T23:00:00Z. To start canary: `/deploy start staging v2.3.1 --canary 5% --notify ops`
samantha: I'll draft the internal blurb for #eng and #support: short TL;DR, rollback criteria, owner list. Ping me when canary passes.
lee: Quick check — pinned runtime image `redwood/runtime:2025-10-28-qt` in the manifest?
morgan: yes pinned. manifest excerpt: ```yaml
image: redwood/runtime:2025-10-28-qt
model_pin: model-bert-v3.1
```
release-scribe-bot: Draft RN link: https://docs.internal/rn/drafts/rn-v2.3.1 (permissions: eng-release-team)
anita: If canary is clean, we promote to full staging at +30m. If we see perf regression but no errors, consider traffic-shift rollback to v2.3.0 and open incident.
lee: Got it. I'll post canary smoke results in 22:36 UTC thread.
morgan: thanks — last ask: ops pin the internal announce at T-15 (22:45 UTC) so support sees the blurb before cutover. :thumbsup:
